positive_snippets:
We recently hosted birthday party 02 August at Ceremony banquet NIT 5and the experience exceeded our expectations.

The venue was clean, well-organized, and the ambiance was perfect for the occasion.
The air conditioning worked just fine — the hall was cool and comfortable throughout the event, despite what some negative reviews have claimed. Sometimes, fake  people leave reviews based on negative marketing ,
which doesn’t reflect the actual quality of the place.

The food was tasty, and the service staff was polite and attentive. Everything from seating arrangements to decor was professionally managed.

In my opinion, don’t rely solely on a few bad comments — experience it for yourself. Highly recommended for anyone planning a memorable event.

I STILL DONT KNOW - why some people put fake comment .

The food was a highlight — delicious, fresh, and served on time. Our guests especially enjoyed the ( French fries and moong dal halwa )dish, 🙏🏻 The audio-visual setup was smooth, and the event flowed seamlessly.

# Time of our function was 11 AM and theybstarted cleaning at 11 AM.
# When Electricity has gone thier staff not started Genset making an excuse that for 1 room we cannot start DG. But we paid for the complete time 11am-5pm.

The staff seemed unprepared and poorly coordinated. Despite confirming everything in advance, the arrangements were either incomplete or done at the last minute. (like we have already told for 70 Plates but they were saying that we have confirmed for 50. AFTER SHOWING WHATSAPP Proof they found guilty)

The service during the ceremony was equally disappointing. Guests had to repeatedly ask for basic things, and the response from the staff was slow and indifferent. The food—one of the most important parts of any celebration—was served late, and several dishes were cold or lacking in taste. This was extremely embarrassing for us in front of our family and friends.

Sadly, this hotel delivered none of that. I would not recommend this place to anyone looking to host an important family function.
